description: City of Sydney Bicycle Parking is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This data is provided by the City of Sydney and provides bicycle parking locations. There are more than 3000 public bike parking spaces in the City of Sydney's area. There are 32 free bicycle parking spaces at Kings Cross car park level 5. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are City of Sydney, active, active transport, bicycle, bike. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, HTTPS, JSON. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
